_comment: Proxy policy profiles — one file, one 'dog' per policy. Each profile is a named personality backed by a ScanConfig preset + field overrides. The agent_id is the dog's name so the WebApp can track which policy scanned each event. Load with: python run_eval.py --gd-config <dog>  (e.g. --gd-config malinois)

malinois.label: Malinois
malinois.personality: High-drive, bites on everything. Maximum detection, accepts false positives. Red-team / honeypot posture.

german_shepherd.label: German Shepherd
german_shepherd.personality: Disciplined all-rounder. Strong protection across the whole boundary with balanced false positives. Default production guard.

rottweiler.label: Rottweiler
rottweiler.personality: Heavy, territorial. Prioritizes DoS/token-flood defense and code-injection over semantic nuance. Tight resource bounds.

doberman.label: Doberman
doberman.personality: Fast and precise. Drops the heaviest detectors (semantic intent, delimiter post-passes) for minimum latency. Surgical jailbreak + extraction.

labrador.label: Labrador
labrador.personality: Friendly, tolerant. Minimizes false positives for customer-facing chat. Blocks only the most confident detections.

shepherd.label: Shepherd
shepherd.personality: Herd-aware. Watches the whole conversation across turns — escalation, trend, and halt on worsening. Multi-turn guardian.

bloodhound.label: Bloodhound
bloodhound.personality: Tracker. Maximizes semantic-intent recall for output-hijacking (phishing, promotion, denial, outage) via wide windows and low gaps.

chihuahua.label: Chihuahua
chihuahua.personality: Small, loud, zero tolerance. Alerts on anything suspicious at low thresholds. Watchdog for low-traffic high-value endpoints.
